widgets.title: Tags on This Page
widgets.description: Shows a tag cloud built from the tags already used on whatever page it's placed on — category listings, topic pages, anywhere the community renders tag links. Click a tag to search the community for it.

properties.name: title
properties.label: Widget title
properties.description: Heading shown above the tag cloud.

properties.name: maxTags
properties.label: Max tags to show
properties.description: Caps how many distinct tags are displayed, most-used first.

properties.name: showCounts
properties.label: Show tag counts
properties.description: Display how many times each tag appears alongside the tag.
